identification: Box of about 100+ mixed 7 inch singles and EPs, 1960s to 1990s. Notable: The Beatles Long Tall Sally EP (Parlophone mono, probably UK GEP 8913 or an Australian equivalent, pressing unverified), The Beatles Ob-La-Di Ob-La-Da Apple A-8693 (Australian, 1969), plus ABBA, Bob Marley, Powderworks, Soulsister, Wet Wet Wet, Herb Alpert, Italian RCA 45 giri. Sleeves worn with old price stickers; vinyl condition unseen.

viewing_check: Check the vinyl condition of the Beatles EP and the Apple single, the EP label and matrix (UK GEP 8913 vs Australian pressing, solid or 4-prong centre), and flick through the box for 1950s-60s rock and roll, Australian 1960s beat, Elvis, Stones, or picture-sleeve singles that are worth more than the common 1980s-90s pop.
